title: Add autonomy review artifact toolchain validator
summary: Review artifact generation and verification now exist as separate commands. Add one read-only validator that exercises generation, verification, and tamper rejection together so future signing work starts from a mechanically checked artifact pipeline.
expectedFailureModes: Review artifact generation and verification pass separately but fail when composed as the pipeline signing work would depend on.
The validator accepts tampered task or event digests and gives false confidence in review evidence.
The validator writes files, stages changes, commits, or pushes while checking a read-only review artifact pipeline.
nextAction: Add a validate-autonomy-review-artifacts command that generates an artifact, verifies it, rejects a tampered digest, document the command, update status evidence, and validate without writing Git metadata.
